name: 08085 · Swedesboro, NJ
findings: ZIP 08085 (Swedesboro) has 72 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08085 (Swedesboro) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08085 (Swedesboro) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
